value: At the edge of the inner sanctum, Sathrovarr holds Kalecgos in thrall. The blue dragon fights from within a shadowed realm even as allies face the dreadlord outside. When his captor’s hold breaks, Kalecgos is free to lend his strength to the defense.
editorNote: Two forms/realms and Sathrovarr’s control are sourced to encounter locators; validate the original 2.4 presentation and dialogue. Record remains research. Original-client and human source review are still required; no record is promoted to reviewed or published.
